story_type: helicopters drop water on a river ice jam to stop a city flood
hook: Black Hawks dropping water on a frozen river to stop a flood.
narration: Black Hawks dropping water on a frozen river, to stop it from flooding a city.
An ice jam had locked up the Missouri River at Bismarck, North Dakota.
Jammed ice works like a dam, and the water behind it keeps rising.
The North Dakota National Guard sent two UH-60 Black Hawks with buckets slung underneath.
Again and again, they dropped six hundred sixty gallons of water onto the jam to knock the ice loose.
[short pause] The river crested at fifteen point four three feet.
outcome: By the end of the day it had fallen nearly two feet, dropping below minor flood stage.
title: Black Hawks bomb an ice jam with water
description:
North Dakota National Guard UH-60 Black Hawk helicopters drop water to dislodge an ice jam on the Missouri River in Bismarck, North Dakota, on Feb. 29, 2024.

Footage: U.S. National Guard video by Staff Sgt. Samuel Kroll, North Dakota National Guard Public Affairs, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/914352/north-dakota-national-guard-uh-60-black-hawk-helicopters-fight-missouri-river-ice-jams
